significant_events.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
significant_events.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

Mali.title: Mali: what changes the takeover of Kidal by the army?
Mali.summary: By retaking the strategic town of Kidal in northern Mali on Tuesday, the Malian army supported by the Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries achieved a highly symbolic success, almost six months after losing control to the Tuareg separatists. But it is a ghost town deserted by its inhabitants that the central Malian state has recovered without fighting, while Bamako struggles to control its territory in this vast desert country plagued by a jihadist insurgency and the independence claims of Tuareg groups.

Mali.title: The Malian army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal from the Tuareg rebels.. The military announces the implementation of large-scale air and ground operations to neutralize armed groups and destroy their strongholds.. and the withdrawal of the Front for the Liberation of Azawad from the city as the forces advance
Mali.summary: In a landmark military development in northern Mali, the Malian army announced its entry into the strategic city of Kidal, after the fighters of the Tuareg Liberation Front of Azawad withdrew from the city in conjunction with the advance of government forces, in a move that returns the city to army control after months of separatist control.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit: FAMa destroy positions of armed terrorist groups
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 7 (AMAP)– The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, destroyed several positions of armed terrorist groups as part of Operation Dougoukoloko on Wednesday by conducting air-land operations in Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced. In the Eastern Theater, the operations made it possible to neutralize, in Talhandak, terrorist elements .

Mali.title: 900 Tankers Under Escort: What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
Mali.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory — it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

Mali.title: Eastern Theatre: Surgical FAMa offensive, destroyed vehicles and destroyed terrorist retreats
Mali.summary: Eastern Theatre: Surgical offensive of the FAMa, destroyed vehicles and destroyed terrorist retreats Operation Dougoukoloko continues on the Eastern Front, according to an official statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted new air-land operations on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 .

Mali.title: Reclaiming Kidal: A Strategic Turning Point for Security and National Sovereignty
Mali.summary: Recapture of the city of Kidal: THE INTREPID FAMAS CONSOLIDATE THEIR PRESENCE IN KIDAL AFTER A VAST AERO-TERRESTRIAL OPERATION They spoke of the city of Kidal on their media, as an impregnable city, inaccessible or even the indestructible strongholds of their terrorist acolytes. However, the warning had been raised by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian allies of Africa Corps, during the Battle of Anefif .

Mali.title: GAO: release of the first promotion of Cutting and Sewing of the Training Center of the Branch of the Social Service of the Armed Forces
Mali.summary: The graduation ceremony of the first training promotion in Cutting and Sewing of the Training Center of the Branch of the Social Service of the Armed Forces of Military Region No.1 was held on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in the premises of the said Center, at the Firhoun Ag Alinçar camp in Gao . The ceremony took place in the presence of the Zone Commander, Colonel Ibrahim SAMASSA, representatives of the directors of services of the security forces as well as the Prefect of Gao, Benenan MOUNKORO, alongside several guests and personalities from the region.

Mali.title: Kidal taken over by the Malian army, which will change on the Senegalese border
Mali.summary: The takeover of Kidal by the Malian army and its allies could intensify security tensions in eastern Senegal, affecting not only regional security but also commercial activities between Dakar and Bamako, essential for the national economy . The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies from Africa Corps retook Kidal, after the departure of the Azawad Liberation Front.

Mali.title: Malians aspire to return to the city of Kidal
Mali.summary: According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mali, as early as Monday, October 5, "major airstrikes were carried out by the air force to reduce enemy positions. This favoured the recapture of the city of Kidal the next day by the FAMa, without a fight". In the nearby town of Gao, thousands of Kidal residents, such as teacher Almoustapha Maiga, found refuge .

Mali.title: Kidal, what challenges for sustainable stability?
Mali.summary: The recapture of Kidal by the Malian army on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, revived the debate on the conditions for a lasting return to peace in the region. For some Malians, the priority is to strengthen the security system. Others advocate for dialogue and the restoration of basic social services in order to consolidate this presence.

Mali.title: THE TITLES OF OCTOBER 7, 2026
Mali.summary: - After the recapture of Kidal by the army, the Malians are divided between the solutions to stabilize the region. Some propose strengthening the military presence on the ground, but others opt for dialogue. - The city of Macina has been plunged into darkness for more than nine months.

Mali.title: MILITARY COURT OF BAMAKO: five cases on the list of the correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at its headquarters, its ordinary correctional hearing. In total, five (05) cases were on the list, involving several military and civilians. The hearing was presided over by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his fellow magistrates .

Mali.title: Image Published on October 7, 2026 Africa Mali: what changes the recapture of Kidal by the army? By retaking the strategic town of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, the Malian army supported by the Russian paramilitaries of the Africa Corps has...
Mali.summary: (ARCHIVES) Overview of a damaged school in Kidal (Mali), May 9, 2026 By retaking the strategic town of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, the Malian army supported by the Russian Africa Corps paramilitaries achieved a highly symbolic success, nearly six months after losing control to Tuareg separatists But it is a ghost town deserted by its inhabitants that the central Malian state has recovered without fighting, while Bamako struggles to control its territory in this vast desert country plagued by a jihadist insurgency and the independence claims of Tuareg groups.

Mali.title: Article reserved for Sahel subscribers. Mali: in Kidal, taken over by the army, "the game of cat and mouse" continues International mail
Mali.summary: The city of Kidal, in northeastern Mali, rebounded on the side of the country's armed forces on Tuesday, October 6. To this end, a convoy of the Malian army and its Russian substitutes from the Africa Corps had left on the same day from Anefis, located a hundred kilometers to the south-east . "This new shift is the illustration of a perpetual war of movement in the North of Mali, where the capital of the Adrar des Ifoghas [nickname given to Kidal] changes hands according to lightning offensives and calculated evacuations," writes Sahel Horizon, evoking "a game of cat and mouse" .

Mali.title: Mali: Army enters Kidal without fighting with Russian support
Mali.summary: It was remarkable that the Malian army (Tuesday) entered the city of Kidal, in the far northeast of the country, without any fighting, six months after it fell to the Tuareg rebels, so that the city remains the title of the war that has been raging in this country for more than 15 years The transitional Malian government announced that the army units "strengthened their positions in Kidal", hours after the withdrawal of the "Front for the Liberation of Azawad", and a statement signed by the Minister of Territorial Administration and the government spokesman, General Issa Othman Coulibaly, said that the armed…

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Sudan: 1,770 people displaced in Blue Nile State, according to IOM
Mali.summary: Bamako, Oct. 7 (AMAP) Some 1,770 people from 354 households were displaced Monday from several villages in southern Sudan's Blue Nile State due to the deteriorating security situation, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said Tuesday. According to IOM, the displacements were recorded in several villages in the locality of Wad al-Mahi .

Mali.title: In Mali, the takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army .

Mali.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the challenges facing the Malian army
Mali.summary: Kidal comes back under the control of the Malian army for the second time in less than three years. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) entered this city in northern Mali on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, five months and eleven days after it was taken, on April 25, by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) Allied with the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim), the independence movement had snatched it from Bamako less than three years after the first resumption of November 2023.

Mali.title: FAMa enter Kidal after Fla withdrawal
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces entered Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, five months after leaving the city. In a statement read on national television, government spokesman Brigadier General Issa Ousmane Coulibaly announced that national forces had regained control of this northern regional capital According to the government, the operation mobilized ground and air assets with the support of Russian partners.

Mali.title: "Kidal is and will remain Malian": Choguel Kokalla Maïga's strong tribute to the memory of General Sadio Camara and the bravery of the FAMa
Mali.summary: Message from former Prime Minister Choguel Kokalla MAÏGA, following the consolidation of the military assets of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) in Kidal As part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their Russian partners have launched, since last weekend, a major air-land operation in the Kidal region Five months after the treacherous terrorist attacks of April 25, 2026, which took the life of General Sadio Camara, Minister of State, Minister of Defense and Veterans Affairs, these operations aimed to track down and neutralize the remnants of terrorist armed groups operating throughout the…

Mali.title: Kidal: The end of recess ​The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their foreign partners, signed their return to the city of Kidal yesterday. The large-scale air-land operations they initiated made it possible to track down and neutralize the terrorist groups that were sowing disorder and desolation in the locality.
Mali.summary: FAMa elements operating in the locality In the wake of this overwhelming victory, the General Staff of the Armed Forces invites the people of Kidal to calm down, to be vigilant and to continue their precious collaboration with the Defence and Security Forces. Large-scale operations have been carried out for a few days in the Kidal Region Determined to regain control of this strategic city, the Malian Army has launched an unprecedented offensive aimed at putting pressure on the armed terrorist groups operating in the region.

Mali.title: Mali Army Retakes Kidal With Russian Support
Mali.summary: Mali's army, backed by Russian paramilitary forces, has retaken the northern town of Kidal after Tuareg separatists announced a "strategic and controlled withdrawal" from the area. The Azawad Liberation Front said its forces withdrew without direct fighting, attributing the move to what it described as the disproportionate use of air power by Russia's Africa Corps.

Mali.title: Mali: Junta Forces Retake Strategic Town of Kidal
Mali.summary: Mali's military regained control of the strategic town of Kidal after forcing Tuareg separatists and al-Qaeda-linked jihadists to withdraw following an offensive backed by Russia's Africa Corps. Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies.

Mali.title: The Malian army has regained possession of Kidal
Mali.summary: After airstrikes in recent days in the Kidal region, an impressive land convoy from Gao, then Anefis, entered the Tuareg rebel stronghold on Tuesday afternoon, without encountering resistance. The Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), which had held the city since April 26, withdrew in front of the advance of the column .

Mali.title: Mali: in Kidal, "the army recovered territory, it did not beat its opponent"
Mali.summary: In Mali, the junta of General Goïta managed yesterday Tuesday to recapture the city of Kidal, which it had lost six months ago to the Tuareg rebels of the Fla, the Azawad Liberation Front. The Malian Armed Forces and their Russian allies entered the large city in the far north of the country without a fight yesterday afternoon. Is this the end of the war?

Mali.title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
Mali.summary: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting.

Mali.title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city
Mali.summary: The Malian army regained control of Kidal, in northern Mali, on Tuesday, October 6. The Malian Armed Forces entered the city without resistance. This return comes more than five months after the capture of Kidal by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), allied to the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) Several security sources confirm this entry of the Fama into Kidal.

Mali.title: Mali’s army says it has taken Kidal from Tuareg rebels, with Russia’s help
Mali.summary: Mali’s armed forces have entered the strategic northern city of Kidal, five months after separatist rebels seized it, following an air and ground campaign backed by Russia’s Africa Corps. In a statement carried by state television on Tuesday, Mali’s transitional government said troops had “consolidated their positions” in the city, “supported by their Russian partners”.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Orders Major Curriculum Overhaul
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso‘s military government has announced a comprehensive overhaul of its history, geography, and civic education curricula. The government said the changes are intended to “decolonise” what students are taught as the new school year begins. Higher Education Minister Moumouni Zoungrana said the reform was carried out at the instruction of the prime minister and aimed to correct content inherited from the colonial period.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: here is the method used to de-radicalize young people
Burkina Faso.summary: A "civic and citizen training" provided in a military camp: this is the method used by the Burkinabe authorities to bring young Sunni worshippers back into the republican fold. After four months of supervision combining military discipline and teaching civic values, a hundred supporters of the preacher Mohamad Ishaq Kindo reunited with their families on Sunday, October 4, 2026 .

Burkina Faso.title: Maternal mortality, nutrition, HPV: when professional advocacy starts to change practices
Burkina Faso.summary: Maternal mortality, nutrition, HPV: when professional advocacy begins to change Carbetocin practices against postpartum hemorrhage in Burkina Faso, micronutrients and midwifery recruitment in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), papillomavirus vaccination in Senegal . For almost four years, the advocacy of six associations of health professionals has started to produce concrete changes in these three countries.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: the national gendarmerie in search of Boureima Sanfo
Burkina Faso.summary: The Burkinabe national gendarmerie is looking for Boureima Sanfo, a 51-year-old trader in Hamelé in the province of Ioba, in the southwestern part of Burkina Faso, for acts of "breach of trust", according to a notice launched on Wednesday, October 7, 2026. The trader Boureima Sanfo is wanted by the national gendarmerie for "breach of trust relating to the sum of more than 40,000,000 CFA francs" .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso
Burkina Faso.summary: Human rights violations and abuses against civilians continued during the armed conflict. Military authorities continued their crackdown on the rights to freedom of expression, association and press freedom, through the arrest of journalists, the suspension of media, enforced disappearances and suspensions of NGOs. Read MoreRetains the death penalty only for serious crimes, such as those committed during times of war

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso Opens First Gold Refinery
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has opened its first gold refinery as the West African country seeks to strengthen state control over the commercialisation of its mineral resources and reduce gold smuggling. The country is Africa’s third-largest gold producer, producing more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal in 2025, according to the World Gold Council. Authorities have struggled to regulate informal gold mining, a sector affected by smuggling and jihadist violence.

Niger.title: Kidnapped child in Yaounde: the suspect arrested in Tahoua
Niger.summary: On the run after the abduction of a minor in Yaoundé, a woman, presented as the main suspect, was arrested on 5 October 2026 in Tahoua, Niger, following an operation conducted jointly by the Cameroonian and Nigerien security forces. The girl was found safe and sound. The fugitive will finally have ended in Tahoua .
